scripts.script:
-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Prevent duplicates
if PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("SuperCoolGuiV1") then
    PlayerGui.SuperCoolGuiV1:Destroy()
end

-- Main ScreenGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "SuperCoolGuiV1"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui

-- Main Frame
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 390)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0.5, -195)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
MainCorner.Parent = MainFrame

local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
MainStroke.Thickness = 2
MainStroke.Transparency = 0.2
MainStroke.Parent = MainFrame

-- TopBar / Header
local TopBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TopBar.Name = "TopBar"
TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
TopBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 28)
TopBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
TopBar.Parent = MainFrame

local TopBarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
TopBarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
TopBarCorner.Parent = TopBar

local TopBarFix = Instance.new("Frame")
TopBarFix.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6)
TopBarFix.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -6)
TopBarFix.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 28)
TopBarFix.BorderSizePixel = 0
TopBarFix.Parent = TopBar

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Text = "SUPER COOLGUI V1"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
Title.TextSize = 15
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Title.Parent = TopBar

-- Dragging Logic
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

TopBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- Content Area
local Content = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
Content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -55)
Content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 48)
Content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Content.BorderSizePixel = 0
Content.ScrollBarThickness = 3
Content.Parent = MainFrame

local ContentLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
ContentLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
ContentLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
ContentLayout.Parent = Content

-- V2 Coming Soon Notice Label
local NoticeLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
NoticeLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
NoticeLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
NoticeLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
NoticeLabel.Text = "V2 Will Be Coming Soon!"
NoticeLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120)
NoticeLabel.TextSize = 13
NoticeLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
NoticeLabel.Parent = Content

-- 1. WalkSpeed TextBox
local SpeedBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
SpeedBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
SpeedBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
SpeedBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
SpeedBox.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
SpeedBox.PlaceholderText = "Enter WalkSpeed (e.g. 50)..."
SpeedBox.Text = ""
SpeedBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
SpeedBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
SpeedBox.TextSize = 13
SpeedBox.Parent = Content

local BoxCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
BoxCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
BoxCorner.Parent = SpeedBox

SpeedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
    if enterPressed and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local val = tonumber(SpeedBox.Text)
        if val then
            LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = val
        end
    end
end)

-- 2. JumpPower TextBox
local JumpBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
JumpBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
JumpBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
JumpBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
JumpBox.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
JumpBox.PlaceholderText = "Enter JumpPower (e.g. 100)..."
JumpBox.Text = ""
JumpBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
JumpBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
JumpBox.TextSize = 13
JumpBox.Parent = Content

local JumpCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
JumpCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
JumpCorner.Parent = JumpBox

JumpBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
    if enterPressed and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local val = tonumber(JumpBox.Text)
        if val then
            local humanoid = LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid
            humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
            humanoid.JumpPower = val
        end
    end
end)

-- 3. Toggle Noclip Button
local NoclipBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
NoclipBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
NoclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 20, 20)
NoclipBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
NoclipBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
NoclipBtn.Text = "Toggle Noclip: OFF"
NoclipBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
NoclipBtn.TextSize = 13
NoclipBtn.Parent = Content

local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
BtnCorner.Parent = NoclipBtn

local noclipActive = false
NoclipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    noclipActive = not noclipActive
    if noclipActive then
        NoclipBtn.Text = "Toggle Noclip: ON"
        NoclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 20, 20)
    else
        NoclipBtn.Text = "Toggle Noclip: OFF"
        NoclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 20, 20)
    end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if noclipActive and LocalPlayer.Character then
        for _, part in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- 4. Toggle InfJump Button
local InfJumpBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
InfJumpBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
InfJumpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 40, 20)
InfJumpBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
InfJumpBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
InfJumpBtn.Text = "Toggle InfJump: OFF"
InfJumpBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
InfJumpBtn.TextSize = 13
InfJumpBtn.Parent = Content

local InfBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
InfBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
InfBtnCorner.Parent = InfJumpBtn

local infJumpActive = false
InfJumpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    infJumpActive = not infJumpActive
    if infJumpActive then
        InfJumpBtn.Text = "Toggle InfJump: ON"
        InfJumpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 80, 20)
    else
        InfJumpBtn.Text = "Toggle InfJump: OFF"
        InfJumpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 40, 20)
    end
end)

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if infJumpActive and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end
end)

-- 5. Reset Button
local ResetBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ResetBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
ResetBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
ResetBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
ResetBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ResetBtn.Text = "Reset All Stats"
ResetBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
ResetBtn.TextSize = 13
ResetBtn.Parent = Content

local ResetCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ResetCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
ResetCorner.Parent = ResetBtn

ResetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    noclipActive = false
    NoclipBtn.Text = "Toggle Noclip: OFF"
    NoclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 20, 20)
    
    infJumpActive = false
    InfJumpBtn.Text = "Toggle InfJump: OFF"
    InfJumpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 40, 20)
    
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local humanoid = LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
        humanoid.JumpPower = 50
    end
end)

scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for Huss Valley uses FishyUI and opens with RightShift. Its Runner tab automates safe-zone routing, revives downed allies, collects gems, avoids catchers with predictive threat vectors, and can override runner speed, dash, and emergency fallback behavior. The Catcher tab chases runners, prioritizes tackle or melee, predicts target movement, and includes smart targeting plus its own speed and turn controls. A Wheel tab automates spins with credit thresholds and cooldowns, and also offers manual spin and state refresh. Journey automation claims seasonal rewards on a loop, while Map Vote can automatically vote for Map 1, 2, or 3 and announce the choice. Utilities cover target-follow camera, goal/threat/hitbox visuals, a debug panel, and suppression of the game’s built-in AFK flag in the lobby. Settings handle notifications, anti-idle kick, rejoin, Discord copy, config saving, and a full unload that restores native walk speed and cleans up visuals and connections.

scripts.title: Focus v2 (READ DESC)
scripts.script:
-- =============================================
-- FOCUS SCRIPT com Rayfield + Aimbot + Botão M1 Flutuante
-- =============================================
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ========== CONFIGURAÇÕES ==========
local FocusEnabled = false
local AimbotEnabled = false
local TargetPlayer = nil
local FocusDistance = 15
local M1Duration = 0.6
local AimbotSmoothness = 0.25

-- Controle do M1
local m1Active = false

-- ========== JANELA ==========
local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Focus Script",
    LoadingTitle = "Focus",
    LoadingSubtitle = "by Assistente",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = true,
        FolderName = "FocusScript",
        FileName = "FocusConfig"
    },
    KeySystem = false
})

-- ========== ABA MAIN ==========
local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)
MainTab:CreateSection("Focus")

local FocusToggle = MainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Ativar Focus",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "FocusToggle",
    Callback = function(value)
        FocusEnabled = value
        if FocusEnabled then
            TargetPlayer = getRandomTarget()
            if not TargetPlayer then
                Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Focus", Content = "Nenhum jogador disponível!", Duration = 3})
                FocusEnabled = false
                FocusToggle:Set(false)
            end
        else
            TargetPlayer = nil
        end
    end
})

MainTab:CreateSection("Aimbot")

local AimbotToggle = MainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Ativar Aimbot (mira na cabeça)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "AimbotToggle",
    Callback = function(value) AimbotEnabled = value end
})

-- ========== ABA SETTINGS ==========
local SettingsTab = Window:CreateTab("Configurações", 4483362458)
SettingsTab:CreateSection("Focus")

SettingsTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Distância acima do alvo",
    Range = {1, 100},
    Increment = 1,
    Suffix = "studs",
    CurrentValue = 15,
    Flag = "FocusDistanceSlider",
    Callback = function(value) FocusDistance = value end
})

SettingsTab:CreateSection("Aimbot")

SettingsTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Suavidade do Aimbot",
    Range = {0, 100},
    Increment = 1,
    Suffix = "%",
    CurrentValue = 25,
    Flag = "AimbotSmoothSlider",
    Callback = function(value) AimbotSmoothness = value / 100 end
})

SettingsTab:CreateSection("M1")

SettingsTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Duração do M1 (tempo colado no alvo)",
    Range = {1, 20},
    Increment = 1,
    Suffix = "x0.1s",
    CurrentValue = 6, -- 0.6s
    Flag = "M1DurationSlider",
    Callback = function(value) M1Duration = value / 10 end
})

-- ========== FUNÇÕES ==========

function getRandomTarget()
    local validTargets = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = player.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and char.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                table.insert(validTargets, player)
            end
        end
    end
    if #validTargets > 0 then
        return validTargets[math.random(1, #validTargets)]
    end
    return nil
end

function getLocalHRP()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
    return nil
end

-- =============================================
-- FUNÇÃO SEGURA PARA OLHAR PARA UM PONTO
-- (Evita NaN quando a distância é 0)
-- =============================================
function safeLookAt(fromPos, toPos)
    local diff = fromPos - toPos
    -- Se os pontos forem praticamente iguais, evita NaN
    if diff.Magnitude < 0.05 then
        return CFrame.new(fromPos)
    end
    return CFrame.new(fromPos, toPos)
end

-- =============================================
-- M1 REAL DO MOUSE
-- =============================================
function fireRealM1()
    pcall(function()
        if mouse1click then mouse1click() end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
        local x, y = mouse.X, mouse.Y
        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 1)
        task.wait(0.03)
        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 1)
    end)
end

-- =============================================
-- M1: COLA A HITBOX NO ALVO
-- =============================================
function doM1Teleport()
    if m1Active then return end

    local myHRP = getLocalHRP()
    if not myHRP then return end

    -- Garante um alvo
    local targetChar = TargetPlayer and TargetPlayer.Character
    if not targetChar or not targetChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or targetChar.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        TargetPlayer = getRandomTarget()
        targetChar = TargetPlayer and TargetPlayer.Character
    end
    if not targetChar then return end

    local targetHRP = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHRP then return end

    m1Active = true

    -- Cola no alvo: fica LIGEIRAMENTE acima (1 stud) para evitar NaN
    -- e mantém a direção do próprio alvo
    local targetPos = targetHRP.Position
    local myNewPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)

    -- Usa a própria orientação do alvo, virado pra ele
    myHRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(myNewPos) * (targetHRP.CFrame - targetHRP.CFrame.Position)

    myHRP.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    myHRP.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero

    -- Dispara o M1 real
    task.wait(0.05)
    fireRealM1()

    -- Após o tempo configurado, sai do modo "colado"
    task.delay(M1Duration, function()
        m1Active = false
    end)
end

-- =============================================
-- FOCUS (sem paralizar)
-- =============================================
function updateFocus()
    if not FocusEnabled or not TargetPlayer then return end

    local targetChar = TargetPlayer.Character
    if not targetChar then
        TargetPlayer = getRandomTarget()
        return
    end

    local targetHRP = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetHum = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not targetHRP or not targetHum or targetHum.Health <= 0 then
        TargetPlayer = getRandomTarget()
        return
    end

    local myHRP = getLocalHRP()
    if not myHRP then return end

    local targetPos = targetHRP.Position

    if m1Active then
        -- Modo M1: cola no alvo (1 stud acima pra evitar NaN)
        local newPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        -- Mantém a rotação do alvo, mas não usa lookAt pra não dar NaN
        myHRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos) * (targetHRP.CFrame - targetHRP.CFrame.Position)
    else
        -- Modo normal: fica na distância configurada acima, olhando pro alvo
        local newPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(0, FocusDistance, 0)
        myHRP.CFrame = safeLookAt(newPos, targetPos)
    end

    myHRP.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    myHRP.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

-- =============================================
-- AIMBOT
-- =============================================
function updateAimbot()
    if not AimbotEnabled or not TargetPlayer then return end

    local targetChar = TargetPlayer.Character
    if not targetChar then return end

    local targetHead = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHead then return end

    local headPos = targetHead.Position
    local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local desiredCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, headPos)

    if AimbotSmoothness <= 0 then
        Camera.CFrame = desiredCFrame
    else
        Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(desiredCFrame, 1 - AimbotSmoothness)
    end
end

-- ========== LOOPS ==========
RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if FocusEnabled or m1Active then
        updateFocus()
    end
end)

RunService:BindToRenderStep("FocusAimbotCam", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
    if AimbotEnabled then updateAimbot() end
end)

-- ========== MORTES ==========
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    hum.Died:Connect(function()
        if FocusEnabled then
            FocusEnabled = false
            if FocusToggle then FocusToggle:Set(false) end
            TargetPlayer = nil

scripts.script:
-- whatHub v1.5 Full Integrated (Enable All Settings master toggle)
-- Last edited: 2025-09-11
-- add me on discord: tennisballs9000

if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DarkNetworks/Infinite-Yield/main/latest.lua'))()

-- ===== Services =====
local Players            = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService         = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace          = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInput          = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting           = game:GetService("Lighting")
local StarterGui         = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local ReplicatedStorage  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Remove any previous whatHub GUIs
pcall(function()
    local pg = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    for _, gui in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
        if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and (gui.Name:match("^whatHub") or gui.Name:match("^whatHub_v")) then
            gui:Destroy()
        end
    end
end)

-- Rayfield loader - try a few times
local Rayfield
do
    local attempts, maxAttempts, lastErr = 0, 3, nil
    while attempts < maxAttempts do
        attempts = attempts + 1
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            return loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()
        end)
        if ok and res then
            Rayfield = res
            break
        else
            lastErr = res
            task.wait(0.6)
        end
    end
    if not Rayfield then
        pcall(function()
            StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
                Title = "whatHub v1.5",
                Text = "Rayfield failed to load, UI will use fallback.",
                Duration = 6
            })
        end)
        Rayfield = {
            CreateWindow = function() 
                return {
                    CreateTab = function() 
                        return {
                            CreateButton = function(_) end,
                            CreateToggle = function(_) end,
                            CreateSlider = function(_) end,
                            CreateSearch = function(_) end,
                            CreateDropdown = function(_) end
                        } 
                    end
                }
            end,
            Notify = function() end
        }
    end
end

-- Safe debug printing
local function dprint(...)
    if _G.whatHubDebug then
        local args = table.pack(...)
        local out = {}
        for i = 1, args.n do out[i] = tostring(args[i]) end
        print("[whatHub DEBUG]", table.concat(out, " "))
    end
end

-- Window
local Window
pcall(function()
    Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
        Name = "whatHub v1.5",
        LoadingTitle = "whatHub Loader",
        LoadingSubtitle = "Made by tennisballs9000",
        ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
        KeySystem = false
    })
end)
Window = Window or { CreateTab = function() return { CreateButton = function() end, CreateToggle = function() end, CreateSlider = function() end, CreateSearch = function() end } end }

local function notify(title, content, dur)
    dur = dur or 3
    pcall(function() Rayfield:Notify({ Title = title, Content = content, Duration = dur }) end)
end

-- Character refs - keep updated
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid  = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local HRP       = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local function updateCharRefs(char)
    if not char then return end
    Character = char
    Humanoid  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    HRP       = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    dprint("Character refs updated")
end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(updateCharRefs)

-- Helpers
local function setNoclip(state)
    if not Character then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(Character:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function() part.CanCollide = not state end)
        end
    end
end

local function safeTeleportToCFrame(cf)
    if not Character or not HRP then return false end
    setNoclip(true)
    pcall(function() HRP.CFrame = cf end)
    task.wait(0.12)
    setNoclip(false)
    return true
end

-- streamed-area check
local function isAreaStreamed(position, radius, minParts)
    radius = radius or 25
    minParts = minParts or 6
    local ok, parts = pcall(function() return Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, radius) end)
    if not ok or not parts then return false end
    local cnt = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then cnt = cnt + 1 end
    end
    return cnt >= minParts
end

-- Tabs
local MovementTab = Window:CreateTab("Movement", 4483362458)
local LegitTab     = Window:CreateTab("Legit", 4483362458)
local StagesTab    = Window:CreateTab("Stages", 4483362458)

-- Movement defaults
local DEFAULT_WALK = 16
local DEFAULT_JUMP = 50
_G.whatHubDebug = false
_G.whatHub_ws = _G.whatHub_ws or DEFAULT_WALK
_G.whatHub_jp = _G.whatHub_jp or DEFAULT_JUMP

MovementTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "WalkSpeed",
    Range = { DEFAULT_WALK, 500 },

    CurrentValue = _G.whatHub_ws,

})

local NoSlowdown = false

        NoSlowdown = v
        notify("Movement", "NoSlow " .. (v and "ON" or "OFF"))
    end
})

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if Humanoid then
        pcall(function()
            if _G.whatHub_ws and Humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= _G.whatHub_ws and not NoSlowdown then Humanoid.WalkSpeed = _G.whatHub_ws end
            if _G.whatHub_jp and Humanoid.JumpPower ~= _G.whatHub_jp and not NoSlowdown then Humanoid.JumpPower = _G.whatHub_jp end
            if NoSlowdown then
                if Humanoid.WalkSpeed < DEFAULT_WALK then Humanoid.WalkSpeed = DEFAULT_WALK end
                if Humanoid.JumpPower < DEFAULT_JUMP then Humanoid.JumpPower = DEFAULT_JUMP end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- Light switch toggle (uses ClickDetector interaction)
local lightActive = false
local lightTask = nil

LegitTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Light Switch",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        lightActive = state

        if lightTask then
            lightTask:Disconnect()
            lightTask = nil
        end

        lightTask = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local lightSwitch = workspace:FindFirstChild("light")
            if not lightSwitch then return end

            local interactive = lightSwitch:FindFirstChild("LightSwitch") and lightSwitch.LightSwitch:FindFirstChild("Interactive")
            local lightsOnBool = lightSwitch:FindFirstChild("LightsOn")
            if not interactive or not lightsOnBool then return end

            local clickDetector = interactive:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
            if not clickDetector then return end

            -- Only act if the state is not as desired
            if (lightActive and not lightsOnBool.Value) or (not lightActive and lightsOnBool.Value) then
                if not HRP then return end
                local originalCFrame = HRP.CFrame

                -- Teleport to switch
                safeTeleportToCFrame(interactive.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,3,0))

                -- Simulate click (call MouseClick on ClickDetector)
                pcall(function()
                    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if player == LocalPlayer then
                            clickDetector.MouseClick:Fire(player)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end)

                -- Wait a short moment for boolvalue to update (or use a small poll to ensure)
                local waited = 0
                while waited < 2 and lightsOnBool and lightsOnBool.Value ~= lightActive do
                    task.wait(0.12)
                    waited = waited + 0.12
                end

                -- teleport back (fail-safe after 2 seconds if not matching desired state)
                safeTeleportToCFrame(originalCFrame)
            end
        end)
    end
})

-- Other settings (fog, ambience, haze, neon, killbricks, player events)
local OriginalLightingState = { FogStart = Lighting.FogStart, FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd }
local OriginalAtmosphereProps = nil
do
    local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
    if atm then OriginalAtmosphereProps = { Density = atm.Density, Offset = atm.Offset, Color = atm.Color } end
end

OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "No Fog",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then
            OriginalLightingState.FogStart = Lighting.FogStart
            OriginalLightingState.FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd
            Lighting.FogStart = 0
            Lighting.FogEnd = 1e9
            local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
            if atm then pcall(function() atm.Density = 0 end) end
            notify("Other", "NoFog enabled", 2)
        else
            Lighting.FogStart = OriginalLightingState.FogStart or 0
            Lighting.FogEnd = OriginalLightingState.FogEnd or 1000
            local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
            if atm and OriginalAtmosphereProps then
                pcall(function()
                    atm.Density = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Density
                    atm.Offset  = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Offset
                    atm.Color   = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Color
                end)
            end
            notify("Other", "NoFog disabled", 2)
        end
    end
})

OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Disable Ambient Sounds",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        -- updated ambient sound targets per user request
        local s1 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Rumble Ambience Interior Wind Turbo Shaft 5 (SFX)")
        local s2 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Sound")
        if s1 and s1:IsA("Sound") then pcall(function() s1.Volume = v and 0 or 1 end) end
        if s2 and s2:IsA("Sound") then pcall(function() s2.Volume = v and 0 or 1 end) end

-- haze toggle

})

-- Neon removal
local neonCache = {}
local function removeNeonNow()
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
            neonCache[obj] = Enum.Material.Neon
            pcall(function() obj.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic end)
        end
    end
end
local function restoreNeonNow()
    for part, mat in pairs(neonCache) do
        if part and part.Parent and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function() part.Material = mat end)
        end
    end
    neonCache = {}
end

OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Remove Neon",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        if state then
            removeNeonNow()
            notify("Other", "Neon parts changed to Plastic", 2)
        else
            restoreNeonNow()
            notify("Other", "Neon parts restored", 2)
        end
    end
})

-- antikillbricks (persistent)
local killWatcherConnection = nil
local function removeTouchFromInstance(inst)
    if not inst then return 0 end
    local removed = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TouchTransmitter") or child:IsA("TouchInterest") then
            pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
            removed = removed + 1
        end
    end
    return removed
end

local function purgeAllKillTouches()
    local count = 0
    for _, inst in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
            local lname = tostring(inst.Name):lower()
            if lname:find("kill") or inst.Name == "Part" then
                count = count + removeTouchFromInstance(inst)
            end
        end
    end
    return count
end

OtherTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Remove KillBricks",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then
            local removed = purgeAllKillTouches()
            killWatcherConnection = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                if obj:IsA("TouchTransmitter") or obj:IsA("TouchInterest") then
                    local parent = obj.Parent
                    if parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local pname = tostring(parent.Name):lower()
                        if pname:find("kill") or parent.Name == "Part" then
                            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            notify("Other", "KillBrick remover enabled - removed " .. tostring(removed) .. " currently.", 3)
        else
            if killWatcherConnection then killWatcherConnection:Disconnect(); killWatcherConnection = nil end
            notify("Other", "KillBrick remover disabled", 2)
        end
    end
})

-- Enable All Settings master toggle (snapshot / apply / restore)
local masterActive = false
local masterSnapshot = {
    ambientVolumes = {},
    haze = nil,
    neonCacheSnapshot = {},
    playerEventsEnabled = nil,
    noFog = nil
}

local function takeSnapshot()
    local s1 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Sound")
    local s2 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Echoing Wind - 60sec Horror Ambient")
    masterSnapshot.ambientVolumes[1] = (s1 and s1:IsA("Sound")) and s1.Volume or nil
    masterSnapshot.ambientVolumes[2] = (s2 and s2:IsA("Sound")) and s2.Volume or nil

    masterSnapshot.haze = Atmos.Haze

    masterSnapshot.neonCacheSnapshot = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
            masterSnapshot.neonCacheSnapshot[obj] = Enum.Material.Neon
        end
    end

    masterSnapshot.playerEventsEnabled = PlayerEventsToggle.CurrentValue

    masterSnapshot.noFog = (Lighting.FogStart == 0 and Lighting.FogEnd > 1e6)
end

local function applyAllSettings()
    local s1 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Sound")
    local s2 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Echoing Wind - 60sec Horror Ambient")
    if s1 and s1:IsA("Sound") then pcall(function() s1.Volume = 0 end) end
    if s2 and s2:IsA("Sound") then pcall(function() s2.Volume = 0 end) end

    Atmos.Haze = 0

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
            neonCache[obj] = Enum.Material.Neon
            pcall(function() obj.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic end)
        end
    end

    if not masterSnapshot.noFog then
        pcall(function()
            Lighting.FogStart = 0
            Lighting.FogEnd = 1e9 -- lol
        end)
    end

    purgeAllKillTouches()
end

local function restoreAllSettings()
    local s1 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Sound")
    local s2 = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Echoing Wind - 60sec Horror Ambient")
    if s1 and s1:IsA("Sound") and masterSnapshot.ambientVolumes[1] ~= nil then pcall(function() s1.Volume = masterSnapshot.ambientVolumes[1] end) end
    if s2 and s2:IsA("Sound") and masterSnapshot.ambientVolumes[2] ~= nil then pcall(function() s2.Volume = masterSnapshot.ambientVolumes[2] end) end

    if masterSnapshot.haze ~= nil then
        pcall(function() Atmos.Haze = masterSnapshot.haze end)
    end

    for part, _ in pairs(neonCache) do
        if part and part.Parent and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            if masterSnapshot.neonCacheSnapshot[part] then
                pcall(function() part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon end)
            end
        end
    end
    neonCache = {}

    if masterSnapshot.noFog == false then
        Lighting.FogStart = OriginalLightingState.FogStart or 0
        Lighting.FogEnd = OriginalLightingState.FogEnd or 1000
        local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
        if atm and OriginalAtmosphereProps then
            pcall(function()
                atm.Density = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Density
                atm.Offset = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Offset
                atm.Color = OriginalAtmosphereProps.Color
            end)
        end
    end
end

LegitTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Enable All Settings",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then
            if masterActive then return end
            takeSnapshot()
            masterActive = true
            applyAllSettings()
            notify("Legit", "Enable All Settings ON (temporary override active)", 3)
        else

            restoreAllSettings()
            masterActive = false
            notify("Legit", "Enable All Settings OFF (reverted)", 3)
        end
    end
})

-- Optimization Machine 9000 - helper to remove by path array
local function removeByPath(pathArray)
    if type(pathArray) ~= "table" or #pathArray == 0 then return false end
    local ok, target = pcall(function()
        local cur = Workspace
        for i, nm in ipairs(pathArray) do
            if not cur then return nil end
            local child = cur:FindFirstChild(nm)
            if not child then return nil end
            cur = child
        end
        return cur
    end)
    if not ok or not target then return false end
    -- detach then destroy to minimize transient overhead
    pcall(function() target.Parent = nil end)
    pcall(function() target:Destroy() end)
    return true
end

})

                local inst = Workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
                if inst then
                    inst.Parent = nil
                    inst:Destroy()
                    ok1 = true
                end
            end)
            if not ok1 then
                pcall(function()
                    local wfold = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Workspace")
                    if wfold and wfold:FindFirstChild(name) then
                        local inst2 = wfold:FindFirstChild(name)
                        inst2.Parent = nil
                        inst2:Destroy()
                        ok1 = true
                    end
                end)
            end
            if ok1 then removedCount = removedCount + 1 end
        end
        if removedCount > 0 then
            notify("Optimization", "Removed " .. tostring(removedCount) .. " extra folders/items", 3)
        else
            notify("Optimization", "No extra folders found to remove", 3)
        end
    end
})
